metadata.component_overlap: component timing categories must not be summed blindly to obtain T_total.

timing_definitions.T_total: Assembled standalone method estimate = T_shared_initial + T_method_initial + T_outer; not a contiguous stopwatch. Shared initialization is executed once in its original position and charged once to each method. Python startup, common problem/u0/g0 construction, certification, plotting, summaries and file I/O are excluded.
timing_definitions.T_shared_initial: Original interval from before H0=dense_hessian through h0_norm: initial dense Hessian, shared ordinary eigendecomposition, original diagnostics, lam_min and h0_norm.
timing_definitions.T_H0_build: Complete original shared dense_hessian call, including finite-difference HVP and state/adjoint work.
timing_definitions.T_shared_spectrum: Original shared np.linalg.eigh(H0). The subsequent make_method eigendecomposition is unchanged.
timing_definitions.T_shared_other: T_shared_initial minus T_H0_build and T_shared_spectrum, including original diagnostics and instrumentation overhead.
timing_definitions.T_method_initial: Original method preparation from t76_begin_method to t76_end_method, including metric construction/setup and initial eigenspace.
timing_definitions.T_setup_update: Equal to T_metric_setup: actual initial metric construction/factorization only. H1 sparse conversion/factorized; shifted-Cholesky delta/construction/factorization; frozen-spectral eps_spec/construction/factorization. Common PDE matrices excluded. No metric updates; update_count=0.
timing_definitions.T_metric_setup: Existing initial metric setup interval measured by t76_metric from the method preparation start. Standard identity has zero.
timing_definitions.T_apply_solve: T_metric_apply + T_metric_solve, including only actual explicit metric callable executions. No added metric operations; Standard identity has zero.
timing_definitions.T_metric_apply: Original explicit metric apply callable executions, including initial M-normalization and frame normalizations.
timing_definitions.T_metric_solve: Original explicit metric solve callable executions in state directions and frame updates.
timing_definitions.T_eig: Inclusive diagnostic = T_H0_build + T_shared_spectrum + T_initial_eig + T_frame. Includes nested metric work also recorded in T_apply_solve.
timing_definitions.T_initial_eig: Original make_method including ordinary/generalized eigensolver, selection, normalization and kappa/L_M0. Internal generalized-eigensolver work remains here.
timing_definitions.T_frame: Original direction-update blocks, including HVP/state/adjoint work, Rayleigh/projection, normalization and nested metric apply/solve.
timing_definitions.T_outer: Original run entry through the end of the unchanged outer loop, stopping before final_index. Includes residual/cost/history/state/frame work and timing overhead.
timing_definitions.T_cert: Only the original final_index call: endpoint dense Hessian, eigvalsh and Morse-index threshold/count computation. Outside T_total.
timing_definitions.T_cert_Hessian: Original dense_hessian subinterval within final_index, included in T_cert only.
timing_definitions.legacy_history_time: Original output time and per-point history clocks retained separately; excluded from numerical equality checks.
timing_definitions.nonconverged_T_total: Consumed wall-clock until termination, not time-to-solution. No speedup is reported for nonconverged methods.

numerical_regression.comparison: Exact equality; numpy.array_equal(equal_nan=True), including shape and dtype
numerical_regression.scope: All parameters, shared initialization, initial frames and dense metrics, complete iteration/residual histories, returned u/y/gradient norm/J/index/status, operation counts and backend; clocks excluded.
